name: Usage
description:
Token-usage stats overlay. The /usage command opens an interactive footer overlay. The overlay shows total tokens and cost across all saved sessions, as ASCII bar charts. It breaks the totals down by provider and model.

Left and Right switch the time window (Today, Last 24h, Last 30d, YTD, Last year, All time). Keys 1-6 jump to a window. Esc closes the overlay. The overlay marks real billed usage [R], and transcript-estimated usage [E]. It uses the same data and renderer as the `usage` CLI command. Headless: /usage <period> prints once to scrollback.
